statement.zh: Green 等将拉皮塔文化复合体以齿印戳刺陶器等物质文化组合来界定（Green；Kirch）。
statement.en: Green and others define the Lapita Cultural Complex via dentate-stamped pottery and related assemblages (Green; Kirch).
